$comment: Canonical session control contract. Metadata, TypeScript/C# DTOs and standalone runtime validators are generated from this file. Binary meshes remain cad_protocol.fbs.
transport: WebSocket JSON text control frames. With binary-mesh-v1, requestMeshLOD sends a JSON identity header followed by the unchanged cad_protocol.fbs MeshUpdate binary frame. With binary-preview-v1, requestPreviewMesh sends a separate candidate identity header then unchanged native MeshUpdate bytes.
